sources.title: gpt2: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gpt2 is a 124M-parameter transformer-based language model trained on English text using causal language modeling, maintained by openai-community. The model learns to predict the next token in sequences by masking future tokens during training, making it effective at generating coherent text continuations from prompts. sources.title: ANEForge
sources.snippet: ANEForge is a direct, CoreML-free Python frontend for the Apple Neural Engine: it lowers a tensor graph into one fused Espresso e5rt program and dispatches it to ANE silicon from an ordinary user process, with no CoreML and no special entitlement. These docs are the software manual - how to install, call, train, target, and extend the frontend.
